inserts.message_text:
📋 *Lunar New Year APAC Launch — Coordination Summary*

*Channel review (#model-research & #core-infra):*
• *#model-research:* There was a customer-facing incident (Acme reported a hallucinated refund policy). Team diagnosed it as primarily a retrieval-ranking issue rather than pure hallucination — a reranker + confidence gate (0.85 threshold) tested clean, filtering <2% of legitimate queries. This is resolved/in good shape, not an active fire. Separately, there's an ongoing Smart Summarize quantization effort (INT8) being validated for factuality before enterprise rollout — worth tracking but not launch-blocking for APAC.
• *#core-infra:* There was an OOM incident on inference pods caused by a batch size config push — it was diagnosed (hit a hard CUDA memory ceiling) and reverted, cluster stabilized. Team has since moved on to GPU cost optimization (~7K over budget) and utilization/scheduling improvements. No active technical instability right now, but worth keeping an eye on the cluster scaling conversation before we lock launch infra needs.
✅ Net: no ongoing critical instability that should block scheduling the launch, but both threads are worth monitoring.

*Role verification — Kenji Sato & Robert Chen:*
⚠️ I was *not able to independently confirm* their titles — both Slack profiles have empty title fields. I found no contradicting evidence either; Robert has been actively leading technical/infra decisions in #core-infra and #model-research (consistent with an engineering lead role), but I found no direct evidence in Slack confirming Kenji's APAC growth role specifically. Recommend confirming both roles directly before finalizing responsibilities.

*New channel:* Created *#lunar-new-year-apac-launch* with topic "Lunar New Year Product Launch – APAC Market Coordination." Kenji and Robert have been invited.

*Timeline message:* ⚠️ I searched extensively (keyword search + direct history review across #project-alpha, #project-alpha-dev, and workspace-wide search for "timeline"/"Lunar New Year"/"APAC") and could *not locate* a prior message about the launch timeline to update. Please point me to it directly, or let me know the correct dates and I'll post them fresh.

*Acknowledgements:* Added 👍 reactions to the key resolution messages in both #model-research (confidence gate validation) and #core-infra (incident revert/stabilization confirmation) so the team knows we've seen them.
